split.episode_rule: explicit fraud_episode_id from the dataset; a fraud ring's episodes form one group; each group's span includes its warning period
split.boundary_rule: targets between the episode groups at 60% and 80% of group start times; moved to the midnight within +/-14 days that the fewest groups straddle; straddling groups move whole to the later split

v1.episode_rule: a customer's fraud transactions linked while less than 14 days apart

v2.episode_rule: explicit fraud_episode_id from the dataset; a fraud ring's episodes form one group; each group's span includes its warning period

per_ring.out_of_sample: LSTM only (out-of-fold); DNN, logistic regression and rule scores are in-sample
LSTM only (out-of-fold); DNN, logistic regression and rule scores are in-sample

production_ring_detector.rule: a device used by 2+ customers (app/inference_pipeline.py detect_fraud_rings, unchanged)
production_ring_detector.scope: full v2 history (all splits); the detector is not a trained model

uncertainty.method: customer-cluster bootstrap on the test split, 2000 resamples (seed 42), thresholds fixed at their validation values, 2.5/97.5 percentiles; Wilson 95% intervals for episode-level first-fraud recall

split.rule: customers linked by a fraud ring or a household form one component; components shuffled with seed 42, stratified by has-fraud, split 60/20/20; a component stays together

lstm_ablation_customer_split.method: customer-cluster bootstrap on the customer-split test customers, 2000 resamples (seed 42)

dataset.description: generated v2 synthetic dataset (data/v2), evaluation only
